title: Discovery of Diaryl Piperidone-Sulfonamide as a Novel Dual-Target Inhibitor of STAT3/CAIX Inducing Ferroptosis in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer Cells.
authors: Chen, Lei; Chen, Xiao-Man; Mao, Zhi-Chen; Gou, Yi; Ma, Xian-Li; Wei, Jian-Hua; Huang, Ri-Zhen; Zhang, Ye
one_liner_zh: 该文报道STAT3/CAIX双靶抑制剂设计，含STAT3 SH2域分子对接，但核心是药物化学与细胞表型，非TF-DNA互作建模，方法仅常规对接，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: A series of diaryl piperidone-sulfonamide derivatives were designed as dual inhibitors of STAT3/CAIX and ferroptosis inducers for triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC). The representative compound 7m demonstrated significant antitumor effects against the MDA-MB-231 cell line both in vitro and in vivo. Mechanistically, 7m inhibits the phosphorylation of STAT3, with a binding affinity determined by surface plasmon resonance (SPR) analysis (KD = 60.03 +/- 8.13 muM). Additionally, 7m exhibits potent inhibitory activity against CA IX (IC(50) = 80.45 +/- 39.7 nM) and shows enhanced antitumor activity under hypoxic conditions compared to normoxic conditions. Molecular docking studies suggest a rational binding mode between 7m and the SH2 domain of STAT3, as well as with the CA IX protein. Furthermore, 7m increases the levels of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and lipid peroxides in MDA-MB-231 cells, thereby inducing ferroptosis. These findings provide a novel therapeutic strategy for the treatment of TNBC.
abstract_zh: 设计了一系列二芳基哌啶酮-磺酰胺衍生物，作为STAT3/CAIX的双重抑制剂及铁死亡诱导剂，用于三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）的治疗。代表性化合物7m在体外和体内均对MDA-MB-231细胞系表现出显著的抗肿瘤效果。机制上，7m抑制STAT3的磷酸化，其结合亲和力通过表面等离子体共振（SPR）分析测定（KD = 60.03 ± 8.13 μM）。此外，7m对CA IX表现出强效抑制活性（IC(50) = 80.45 ± 39.7 nM），并在低氧条件下相较于常氧条件下显示出增强的抗肿瘤活性。分子对接研究提示7m与STAT3的SH2结构域及CA IX蛋白之间存在合理的结合模式。进一步地，7m增加MDA-MB-231细胞中活性氧（ROS）和脂质过氧化物的水平，从而诱导铁死亡。这些发现为TNBC的治疗提供了一种新的治疗策略。
